qfd_sp_tree_top.exactness: ot_qfd_spine_part (tree top + VM x root + lanes + port elements, IS=OS=0) against ot_qwen_me_spine_h_w12, every output every cycle: local 20,000 cycles, 555 ops, 8,584 result slots, 0 mismatching cycles (pre-x_rdy build; fleet benches tt_lockstep / tt_lockstep_g192 / tt_mutant in the route jobs)

qfd_sp_vector_memory.structure: 64 row banks (row = 16 elements) x 2 ot_sram_1r1w_256x256 macros = 128 macros, capture flops at the macros (3-slot ring, engine-pause safe); an x tuple (S = 2^split seats at x_dc + c*d) is served as B = floor((S-1)d/1008)+1 beats of 63 consecutive rows (one per bank, conflict-free), rotated (2 stages) and shifted (1 stage), then decimated into an assembly line by a |DSET|:1 mux per entry (fixed wires per stride, DSET = {0,1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24,32,48,64,96}); the line is copied S-periodically to the 2,048 x seats at the fixed edge k+1+XVM (XVM = 15); held tuples (IL slot hold) are not re-read; row write (1/cycle, masked) and row read (credit, RL 3) ports
qfd_sp_vector_memory.serves: the 2,048-seat ME x read every cycle for contiguous tuples (S <= 1008: attention QK S=128, PV S=512) and for strided weight tuples held >= B edges (Qwen3-8B TP4: q/k/v/lm_head S=2048 d=2 B=5, gate/up S=256 d=16 B=5, down S=512 d=6 B=4, o S=512 d=2 B=2; IL hold 8)
qfd_sp_vector_memory.not_served: the split SU's 3 x 64 scalar fixed-latency abutted lane ports (vm_su_service gate stays open)
qfd_sp_vector_memory.exactness: tb_qfd_vector_memory against the token bench's behavioural VM semantics (every seat read at the edge after the descriptor, XVM registers, engine-gated, ELEMS-bounded): local PASS 30,000 cycles, 9,452 tuples, 3,667 row reads, engine pauses 1/8; fleet: 2 seeds, a 64-bank / 1,008-element-beat / 512-seat configuration, mutant
qfd_sp_vector_memory.cost: XVM 1 -> 15 inside the fixed BD x-network budget (x network stages 39 -> 25): 0 cycles; x_rdy gap <= 6 edges per back-to-back ME op
qfd_sp_vector_memory.area_note: ~1.8 mm2 of macros + ~0.3 mm2 logic against the r21 0.725 mm2 slab (route variants 777.6 x 3110.4 and 1555.2 square)

qfd_io_embedding_rom.rtl: rtl/qwen_sys/rtl_finish_20261007/ot_qfd_io_embedding_rom.sv ot_qfd_emb_root + ot_qfd_emb_tap (+ ot_qfd_io_embedding_rom assembly with protocol-faithful behavioural banks)
qfd_io_embedding_rom.structure: root at the die face: request FIFO (its depth = the die-side credits), bank decode (code word a -> bank a>>12, scale row r -> bank 2374 + r>>16), in-order issue to ONE bank at a time over 8 column chains (one request / 2 edges, <= 4 outstanding), response OR-merge; one registered tap beside every bank parent (request chain down, response chain up, 4-entry queue, bank credits)
qfd_io_embedding_rom.exactness: tb_qfd_embedding_rom against the ROM semantics: local PASS 6,000 requests (token rows of 64 code words + scale, random words, random scales), mutant FAIL
